description: Cyberpunk 2077 mod manager: your zip repository stays the only library. Profiles, per-mod and per-stack toggles, a preview before anything is written to the game.
cmd.demande: Red Stack: Handle the Pending Request
conf.python: Python command that runs the engine.
conf.moteur: Path of another red_stack.py than the packaged one (development). Empty: the built-in engine.
conf.donnees: Data folder (profiles, install registry, config.json). Empty: the extension's storage folder. Can also be set from the page, "Settings" button.
conf.actualisationAuto: Re-read the repository and the game on its own when a zip arrives, leaves or changes in a stack, when archive\pc\mod changes, or when a profile is written by another window or a Claude session. Unchecked: only the ↻ button of the page re-reads.
conf.barreEnCouleur: "Red Stack Rouge" and "Red Stack Jaune" themes: every activity bar icon (on the left) takes the accent colour, the active icon is told by its marker. Unchecked: only the active icon is coloured. Writes one line per theme in your settings (workbench.colorCustomizations), removed when the box is unchecked.
conf.langue.auto: VS Code's display language; a language Red Stack does not have falls back to English.
conf.langue: Language of the Red Stack page, its side bar and its messages. Can also be set from the page, "Settings" button, "Language" section.
accueil:
The Red Stack page opens in the editor.
